name: DeepSeek-OCR
license_interpretation: This family covers two releases with different permissive licences. Size "1" is DeepSeek-OCR (paper arXiv:2510.18234), released under MIT: commercial and closed-source use is allowed if you keep the copyright and license notice. Size "2" is DeepSeek-OCR 2 (paper arXiv:2601.20552, 'Visual Causal Flow'), released under Apache-2.0: commercial use is allowed if you keep the license text and notices, and it grants a patent license. LibreYOLO ports the inference path of the Hugging Face releases (deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR at 9f30c71f441d010e5429c532364a86705536c53a and deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR-2 at aaa02f3811945a91062062994c5c4a3f4c0af2b0) and runs none of their remote code; ported parts keep their lineage, Apache-2.0 for the DeepSeek-V2 decoder, the Transformers Llama and Qwen2 attention, the detectron2-derived SAM encoder and the FastChat template, MIT for the ConvNeXt LayerNorm (libreyolo/models/deepseekocr/NOTICE), while the adapter is MIT. Weights are byte-identical, ungated mirrors at LibreYOLO/LibreDeepSeekOCR1 and LibreYOLO/LibreDeepSeekOCR2 with no learned parameter changed.

DeepSeek-OCR 2 (size "2") has its own separate entry, published with this one in the deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR-2 model card at revision aaa02f3811945a91062062994c5c4a3f4c0af2b0: @article{wei2026deepseek, title={DeepSeek-OCR 2: Visual Causal Flow}, journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:2601.20552}, year={2026}}, same three authors; the arXiv API for 2601.20552 matches its title and three authors in order. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.
